{{Quote|There is a gunship blocking our way. OM-5, OM-7, Go check it out.|The OOM command droid|<ref name="Supply Lines">{{TCW|Supply Lines}}</ref>}}
This '''OOM command droid''' led the droid forces against [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ima-Gun Di/Legends|Di]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Keeli/Legends|Keeli]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The droid ordered [[OM-5/Legends|2]] [[OM-7/Legends|B1 battle droids]] to check out a gunship blocking the road. After the inspection from OM-5 and OM-7, the gunship's hidden explosives were triggered destroying both the unsuspecting droids and the nearby pillars which ultimatley led to the road being buried.
